hero.title: Sri Lanka, made personal
hero.subtitle: Handcrafted journeys across the island — ancient cities, wild safaris, surf beaches and misty highlands — planned around you, guided by locals.

points.title: Fully customisable
points.text: Every package bends around you. Pick your destinations and activities on the map — the price recalculates instantly, with no per-activity price tags shown.

points.title: Real local guides
points.text: Choose your own licensed chauffeur-guide or driver. Every guide has a public profile with genuine guest reviews.

points.title: Handpicked stays
points.text: Silver, Gold and Platinum each unlock a wider choice of hotels — from comfortable 3-star gems to 5-star-plus icons. Browse every hotel's own website before you decide.

points.title: Honest pricing
points.text: One total price in your own currency. Customise freely — the total updates, but individual activity prices stay private.

tiers.name: Silver
tiers.lunch: Flexible dining — lunch is arranged around your schedule and location. Choose any restaurant that suits your taste, from local rice & curry to international dining.
tiers.transport: Comfortable sedan with room for your luggage. The vehicle grows with your group — from a sedan for two up to vans and coaches for larger parties.
tiers.guide: English-speaking professional chauffeur who keeps your journey smooth and comfortable.
tiers.accommodation: Carefully selected 3-star to 5-star hotels on half-board (breakfast + dinner), matched to your itinerary and budget.
tiers.idealFor: Travellers who value flexibility, comfortable transport and the freedom to choose their own dining.
tiers.hotelChoiceNote: Choose from 4+ handpicked hotels per destination

tiers.name: Gold
tiers.lunch: Buffet lunch included — Sri Lankan specialities or European-style buffets, arranged along your route.
tiers.transport: Comfortable sedan with generous luggage space, sized to your group.
tiers.guide: Qualified, licensed English-speaking chauffeur-guide who brings the island's culture, history and nature to life. Prefer another language? Request it — subject to availability.
tiers.accommodation: Selected 5-star hotels on half-board (breakfast + dinner). Choose from 5 proposed hotels or name your preferred one.
tiers.idealFor: Travellers seeking enhanced comfort, professional guiding and effortless days.
tiers.hotelChoiceNote: Choose from 5 proposed 5-star hotels per destination

tiers.name: Platinum
tiers.lunch: Your choice, your experience — authentic Sri Lankan, international, fine dining or a special culinary experience, with set-menu options we arrange for you.
tiers.transport: Premium SUV with extra space and comfort, sized to your group and luggage.
tiers.guide: Private, nationally licensed tourist guide speaking your preferred language, for a deeper journey into heritage, culture, nature and wildlife.
tiers.accommodation: Luxury and premium 5-star-plus stays, or your own preferred hotels — shaped around your travel style.
tiers.idealFor: Travellers seeking a premium, personalised experience with full flexibility.
highlights: Lunch — your choice, incl. set menus
tiers.hotelChoiceNote: Choose from 10+ luxury hotels per destination

vibes.name: Cultural & Heritage
vibes.tagline: Ancient kingdoms, sacred temples, living traditions
vibes.description: Walk among 2,000-year-old stupas, climb the rock fortress of Sigiriya, witness the sacred Temple of the Tooth and feel the rhythm of Kandyan dance. The island's soul, told by the people who keep it.

vibes.name: Wildlife & Safari
vibes.description: Track leopards in Yala, watch elephants gather at Minneriya, drift past crocodiles on the Madu river and wake to hornbills in Wilpattu. Sri Lanka packs Africa-scale wildlife into one small island.

vibes.name: Adventure & Coast
vibes.tagline: Surf, raft, hike and dive the island edge
vibes.description: Surf reef breaks in Arugam Bay, raft the rapids of Kitulgala, zipline over Ella's valleys and kitesurf the lagoons of Kalpitiya. Coastal escapes included — the island's best beaches are part of the ride.

vibes.name: Spiritual Journey
vibes.tagline: Sacred sites, quiet minds, ancient wisdom
vibes.description: From the Temple of the Tooth to hillside kovils and forest monasteries — a slower journey through the island's sacred geography, with time for meditation, Ayurveda and reflection.
sampleItinerary: Temple of the Sacred Tooth, Kandy

vibes.name: Economy
vibes.description: All the highlights, planned smartly. Our Economy packages are being crafted now — leave your email and be first to travel more for less.

destinations.name: Negombo
destinations.tagline: Beach town by the lagoon, minutes from the airport
destinations.description: Most journeys begin here — a breezy coastal town of fishing boats, Dutch canals and golden beaches, just 20 minutes from the international airport. Perfect for a soft landing or a final sunset.

activities.name: Negombo lagoon boat safari
activities.description: Glide through mangroves and fishing villages on a quiet morning boat ride.

activities.name: Muthurajawela marsh boat safari
activities.description: Explore Sri Lanka's largest coastal wetland — herons, monkeys and baby crocodiles.

activities.name: Dry fish market
activities.description: A sensory walk through the famous 'Lellama' where the day's catch dries in the sun.

activities.name: St. Mary's Church
activities.description: Negombo's grand neoclassical church, the heart of the town's Catholic heritage.

activities.name: Kitulgala white-water rafting (day trip)
activities.description: Grade 2–3 rapids through rainforest, 2 hours inland — Sri Lanka's rafting capital.

hotels.name: Jetwing Beach
hotels.blurb: Beachfront resort with a large pool, spa and seafood restaurants on Lewis Place.

hotels.name: Heritance Negombo
hotels.blurb: Modern luxury resort with rooftop infinity pool overlooking the ocean.

destinations.name: Kalpitiya
destinations.description: A wild peninsula of lagoons and sandbars — Sri Lanka's kitesurfing mecca in season, with spinner dolphins dancing offshore and Wilpattu's edge a short drive away.

activities.name: Kitesurfing
activities.description: World-class flat-water lagoons from May to October — lessons for every level.

activities.name: Dolphin watching
activities.description: Hundreds of spinner dolphins ride the bow waves on early-morning boat trips.

activities.name: Kalpitiya lagoon kayaking
activities.description: Paddle mangrove channels at sunset as birds return to roost.

hotels.name: Uga Ulagalla (via Anuradhapura)
hotels.blurb: Luxury boutique resort among paddy fields, 1.5 hrs inland — a favourite base for the region.

destinations.name: Wilpattu
destinations.tagline: The land of lakes — leopard country
destinations.description: Sri Lanka's largest national park, a maze of natural lakes ('villus') in dense dry forest. Fewer jeeps, wilder feeling — and some of the island's best leopard sightings.

activities.name: Wilpattu safari (full/half day)
activities.description: Track leopards, sloth bears and elephants through villu-dotted forest with expert trackers.

activities.name: Birdwatching
activities.description: Painted storks, serpent eagles and endemic junglefowl around the villus.

hotels.name: Big Game Camp Wilpattu
hotels.blurb: Luxury tented safari camp on the park's edge — fall asleep to jungle sounds.

destinations.name: Jaffna
destinations.description: Palmyrah palms, vibrant kovils and a cuisine unlike anywhere else on the island. Jaffna rewards curious travellers with Delft's wild horses, Nainativu's temples and unforgettable crab curry.

activities.name: Jaffna Fort & old town
activities.description: Dutch-era ramparts and bustling markets in the peninsula's historic core.

activities.name: Nainativu island temples
activities.description: Ferry to the sacred Nagapooshani Amman kovil and Buddhist Nagadeepa Vihara.

activities.name: Delft Island
activities.description: Wild horses, coral walls and a giant's footprint on this remote island.

activities.name: Jaffna food trail
activities.description: Crab curry, kool and palmyrah toddy — the island's boldest flavours.

hotels.name: Jetwing Jaffna
hotels.blurb: Contemporary hotel in the city centre — the most comfortable base in the north.

destinations.name: Anuradhapura
destinations.description: Two millennia of Buddhist heritage among towering stupas and ancient reservoirs. Cycle between the Sri Maha Bodhi — grown from the original Bodhi tree — and the great Ruwanwelisaya dagoba.

activities.name: Ancient city by bicycle
activities.description: Ride between stupas, monasteries and moonstones with a local guide.

activities.name: Sri Maha Bodhi & Ruwanwelisaya
activities.description: Pay respects at the world's oldest documented tree and the great white dagoba.

activities.name: Kayaking in Kala Wewa
activities.description: Paddle the 1,500-year-old reservoir at golden hour, elephants sometimes at the shore.

hotels.name: Uga Ulagalla
hotels.blurb: Ultra-luxury boutique resort on 58 acres — private pools, paddy fields and superb dining.

destinations.name: Yapahuwa
destinations.tagline: The rock fortress with the lion staircase
destinations.description: A 13th-century citadel rising from the plains, guarded by its famous ornamental lion staircase. Quieter than Sigiriya, just as dramatic — with a forest monastery nearby.

activities.name: Yapahuwa rock fortress climb
activities.description: Climb past stone lions to the palace ruins with sweeping views over the plains.

activities.name: Ridee Viharaya
activities.description: Silver temple with ancient murals, set peacefully among the rocks.

activities.name: Skydiving & para jumping
activities.description: Tandem jumps with island views — for true adrenaline seekers.

destinations.name: Dambulla
destinations.description: Home to the island's best-preserved cave temple complex — 150 Buddha images painted across five caves — and the gateway to the elephant safaris of Minneriya and Kaudulla.

activities.name: Dambulla cave temple
activities.description: Five caves of 2,000-year-old murals and 150 Buddha statues — a UNESCO wonder.

activities.name: Minneriya / Kaudulla elephant safari
activities.description: Watch hundreds of wild elephants gather — 'The Gathering', Asia's greatest wildlife spectacle.

activities.name: Dambulla market
activities.description: The island's biggest produce market — a riot of colour, spice and noise.

activities.name: Authentic Sri Lankan lunch
activities.description: A traditional village lunch, served the local way.

activities.name: Cultural dancing performance
activities.description: Kandyan dancers, drummers and fire acts in the evening.

hotels.name: Heritance Kandalama
hotels.blurb: Geoffrey Bawa's jungle-clad masterpiece wrapped around a rock, overlooking Kandalama lake.

hotels.name: Cinnamon Lodge Habarana
hotels.blurb: Safari-style chalets scattered through forest — monkeys on the lawn at breakfast.

destinations.name: Sigiriya
destinations.tagline: The eighth wonder of the world
destinations.description: A 200-metre rock rising from the jungle, crowned by a 5th-century palace. Climb past the frescoes of the cloud maidens and the giant lion's paws to the summit gardens.

activities.name: Sigiriya rock fortress
activities.description: The iconic climb — frescoes, mirror wall and the sky palace at the top.

activities.name: Pidurangala rock (sunrise/sunset)
activities.description: The rival rock with the best VIEW of Sigiriya — magical at dawn.

activities.name: Village safari
activities.description: Bullock cart, catamaran and a home-cooked village lunch.

activities.name: Hot air balloon ride
activities.description: Drift over the cultural triangle at sunrise — unforgettable.

activities.name: Elephant ride / sanctuary visit
activities.description: Meet elephants ethically at a nearby sanctuary.

activities.name: Silk factory & saree experience
activities.description: See silk being woven and try wearing a traditional saree.

activities.name: Ayurvedic spa treatments
activities.description: Traditional treatments at renowned spas — Athreya, Isiwara Pauwra and Iswara Prana.

hotels.name: Jetwing Vil Uyana
hotels.blurb: Luxury eco-dwellings over wetlands — consistently ranked among the world's best.

hotels.name: Cinnamon Lodge Habarana
hotels.blurb: Forest chalets 20 minutes from the rock.

businesses.name: Sigiriya silk factory
businesses.blurb: Watch silk weaving and try the saree experience — book your visit through Ariva.

destinations.name: Polonnaruwa
destinations.description: The island's second ancient capital — a compact archaeological park of giant Buddha statues, royal palaces and the vast Parakrama Samudra reservoir. Best explored by bicycle.

activities.name: Ancient city cycling tour
activities.description: Gal Vihara's rock Buddhas, the Royal Palace and the Sacred Quadrangle by bike.

activities.name: Parakrama Samudra
activities.description: The 12th-century 'Sea of Parakrama' — walk or boat its bunds at sunset.

destinations.name: Trincomalee
destinations.description: One of the world's great natural harbours, watched over by the cliff-top Koneshwaram Kovil. Whale watching, Pigeon Island snorkelling and some of the island's calmest beaches.

activities.name: Whale watching
activities.description: Blue whales and sperm whales cruise past from March to August.

activities.name: Snorkelling at Pigeon Island
activities.description: Coral gardens, reef sharks and turtles in a marine national park.

activities.name: Surfing (beginners)
activities.description: Gentle beach breaks — learn to stand up in warm water.

activities.name: Koneshwaram Kovil
activities.description: The cliff-top 'Temple of a Thousand Pillars' with staggering ocean views.

activities.name: Natural hot water springs
activities.description: Seven wells of naturally hot water at Kanniya — a local pilgrimage.

activities.name: Nilaveli & Jungle Beach
activities.description: Powder-white sand and swaying palms, minutes from town.

hotels.name: Uga Jungle Beach
hotels.blurb: Beach-chic luxury cabins in coastal jungle, north of Trinco town.

destinations.name: Matale
destinations.tagline: Spice gardens on the road to the hills
destinations.description: A fragrant stopover between the cultural triangle and Kandy — Matale's spice gardens have perfumed this valley for centuries. Walk among cinnamon, cardamom and vanilla with a master grower.

activities.name: Spice garden tour
activities.description: See, smell and taste how cinnamon, pepper, cardamom and Ayurvedic herbs grow — with a herbal head massage to finish.

activities.name: Aluvihara Rock Temple
activities.description: The monastery where the Pali canon was first written down, 2,000 years ago.

businesses.name: Matale spice gardens
businesses.blurb: Family-run gardens with guided tours and Ayurvedic products — visits arranged through Ariva.

destinations.name: Kandy
destinations.description: Sri Lanka's cultural heart — a lakeside city of temples, dancers and colonial streets, guarded by the sacred Temple of the Tooth. No island journey is complete without it.

activities.name: Temple of the Sacred Tooth Relic
activities.description: The island's holiest Buddhist shrine — visit for the evening puja ceremony.

activities.name: Royal Botanical Gardens, Peradeniya
activities.description: 60 hectares of orchids, giant palms and a famous avenue of royal palms.

activities.name: Cultural dancing performance
activities.description: Kandyan dancers, fire-eaters and drummers in a nightly lakeside show.

activities.name: Hanthana mountain hike
activities.description: A half-day ridge walk with the best views over Kandy city.

activities.name: Udawatte Kele sanctuary
activities.description: A pocket of ancient rainforest right behind the Tooth Temple — monkeys, birds and giant lianas.

activities.name: Gem museum
activities.description: Learn how Ceylon sapphires go from mine to jewel — with certified shopping.

activities.name: Wood carving centre
activities.description: Watch master carvers shape masks and elephants from rain tree wood.

activities.name: Pinnawala Elephant Orphanage
activities.description: The world's largest herd of captive elephants, bathing in the river twice daily.

activities.name: Victoria Golf Club, Digana
activities.description: An 18-hole championship course in the hills, 30 minutes from town.

activities.name: Evening high tea
activities.description: Colonial-style high tea with hill-country views.

hotels.name: Earl's Regency
hotels.blurb: Grand hill-country hotel with a huge pool and views over the Knuckles range.

hotels.name: The Grand Hotel Kandy
hotels.blurb: Heritage hotel from 1844 with old-world charm near the lake.

hotels.name: Serendib Signature
hotels.blurb: Boutique comfort in the hills, recommended by our local team.

businesses.name: Kandy gem museum
businesses.blurb: Certified Ceylon sapphires with museum tour — book through Ariva for trusted pricing.

businesses.name: Kandy wood carving centre
businesses.blurb: Traditional masks and sculptures, carved before your eyes.

destinations.name: Nuwara Eliya
destinations.description: Tea estates, colonial bungalows and crisp mountain air at 1,868 metres. Walk Horton Plains to World's End, tour a working tea factory and warm up with proper high tea.

activities.name: Tea plantation & tea safari
activities.description: Pluck tea with the pickers and tour a working factory, from leaf to cup.

activities.name: Horton Plains & World's End
activities.description: A high-plateau walk to a sheer 880m cliff drop — start at dawn.

activities.name: Gregory Park & lake
activities.description: Boating and pony rides around the town's pretty lake.

activities.name: Seetha Amman Kovil
activities.description: The colourful temple where Sita is said to have been held in the Ramayana.

activities.name: Lover's Leap & Ramboda waterfalls
activities.description: Two dramatic falls wrapped in legend and tea country.

activities.name: Pidurutalagala hike
activities.description: Climb the island's highest peak (2,524m) for sunrise over the hill country.

activities.name: Evening high tea
activities.description: Cucumber sandwiches and Ceylon tea in a grand colonial hotel.

hotels.name: Heritance Tea Factory
hotels.blurb: A converted 1930s tea factory — stay where the tea was made.

hotels.name: The Grand Hotel Nuwara Eliya
hotels.blurb: The classic 'Little England' experience since 1891.

destinations.name: Ella
destinations.description: The backpacker's mountain paradise — hike Ella Rock at dawn, cross the Nine Arches Bridge as the blue train passes, and chase waterfalls through tea country.

activities.name: Ella Rock hike
activities.description: The classic 3-hour climb for the island's most famous viewpoint.

activities.name: Little Adam's Peak
activities.description: An easy sunset hike — plus zipline and skywalk at Ravana Adventure Centre.

activities.name: Nine Arches Bridge
activities.description: The iconic viaduct — time it with the passing train for the perfect photo.

activities.name: Ravana Falls & caves
activities.description: Legend says Ravana hid Sita in these caves behind the falls.

activities.name: Nildiya Pokuna natural pool
activities.description: A hidden jungle pool under the rocks — swim if you dare.

activities.name: Traditional cooking experience
activities.description: Learn rice & curry from a local family kitchen.

activities.name: Club nights
activities.description: Ella's famous backpacker nightlife along Passara Road.

hotels.name: 98 Acres Resort & Spa
hotels.blurb: Stunning resort facing Little Adam's Peak — infinity pool above the tea.

destinations.name: Badulla
destinations.description: A working hill town beyond the tourist trail — Dunhinda's misty falls, the colonial-era Bogoda wooden bridge and mountain roads made for slow travel.

activities.name: Dunhinda Falls
activities.description: A 64m cascade in the mist — one of the island's most beautiful falls.

activities.name: Bogoda wooden bridge
activities.description: A 400-year-old roofed wooden bridge, an engineering marvel.

activities.name: Dhowa Temple
activities.description: Ancient rock temple with a 12m unfinished Buddha statue.

destinations.name: Mahiyangana
destinations.description: Meet the Vedda — Sri Lanka's indigenous forest people — in their village near the Mahiyangana stupa. An authentic cultural encounter, arranged respectfully with the community.

activities.name: Vedda village visit
activities.description: Spend time with the indigenous community — their traditions, crafts and forest knowledge.

activities.name: Mahiyangana Raja Maha Vihara
activities.description: One of the island's oldest stupas, marking the Buddha's first visit.

destinations.name: Kumana
destinations.description: A vast wetland wilderness on the east coast — one of Asia's great bird sanctuaries, where painted storks nest in their thousands and leopards pad the sand tracks.

activities.name: Kumana birdwatching safari
activities.description: Black-necked storks, spoonbills and raptors in a pristine wetland park.

destinations.name: Arugam Bay
destinations.description: A legendary right-hand point break on a lazy crescent bay. By day, world-class surf; by night, beach bars and drum circles under the palms.

activities.name: Surfing (experts)
activities.description: Main Point, Whiskey Point and Pottuvil — reef breaks for experienced surfers, May to October.

activities.name: Surf lessons (beginners)
activities.description: Baby Point's gentle whitewater is perfect for first-timers.

activities.name: Club nights
activities.description: Beach parties and live music along the bay strip.

activities.name: Pottuvil lagoon safari
activities.description: Elephants and crocodiles on a quiet mangrove lagoon.

hotels.name: Jetwing Surf
hotels.blurb: Surf-chic beach hotel right on the break.

destinations.name: Yala
destinations.description: The island's most famous national park — the highest leopard density on earth, plus elephants, sloth bears and crocodile-filled lagoons. Add Bundala's birds and Udawalawe's elephants for the full safari circuit.

activities.name: Yala safari (full/half day)
activities.description: Dawn to dusk with expert trackers — leopards, elephants, sloth bears.

activities.name: Bundala birdwatching safari
activities.description: Flamingos, pelicans and 200+ species in the coastal lagoons.

activities.name: Udawalawe elephant safari
activities.description: Guaranteed elephants — herds of 50+ around the reservoir.

activities.name: Tissa lake boat safari
activities.description: Sunset boat ride among lily pads as birds return to roost.

activities.name: Tissamaharama Temple
activities.description: An ancient stupa town on the safari circuit.

hotels.name: Cinnamon Wild Yala
hotels.blurb: Jungle-chic chalets where leopards roam the grounds at night.

hotels.name: Jetwing Yala
hotels.blurb: Beach-meets-jungle luxury with a superb pool.

destinations.name: Bundala
destinations.description: A Ramsar wetland of lagoons and salt pans — flamingos in season, and one of the best places on earth to see greater flamingos and 200+ bird species.

activities.name: Bundala birdwatching safari
activities.description: Flamingos, black-necked storks and crocodiles in golden light.

destinations.name: Tangalle
destinations.description: Long, empty beaches on the deep south coast — Tangalle is where the island exhales. Turtle hatcheries, blowholes and some of the finest beach resorts in the country.

activities.name: Turtle watching
activities.description: Watch green turtles nest by moonlight with conservation guides.

activities.name: Beach days
activities.description: Rekawa, Silent Beach and Goyambokka — pick your perfect crescent.

activities.name: Evening high tea
activities.description: High tea with ocean views at the coast's grand hotels.

hotels.name: Anantara Peace Haven
hotels.blurb: Clifftop luxury resort on a secluded cove.

destinations.name: Hiriketiya
destinations.description: A perfect little horseshoe of turquoise water fringed with palms — 'Hiri' is the island's coolest surf hangout, with beginner waves, beach cafes and jungle all around.

activities.name: Surfing (beginners)
activities.description: Gentle, consistent beach break — the island's friendliest learn-to-surf spot.

activities.name: Relaxing & sunbathing
activities.description: Hammocks, coconuts and beach cafes around the bay.

activities.name: Hummanaya blowhole
activities.description: The island's famous blowhole, shooting seawater 25m skyward.

destinations.name: Kirinda
destinations.description: A quiet fishing village with a sacred rock temple offshore — and one of the island's most important sea turtle nesting beaches. Come at night, leave only footprints.

activities.name: Sea turtle nesting watch
activities.description: Guided night visits to watch turtles lay eggs — a humbling experience.

activities.name: Kirinda temple
activities.description: A tiny rock-island shrine reached by causeway.

destinations.name: Weligama
destinations.description: 'Sandy village' — a 3km curve of golden sand with one of the island's most consistent surf breaks. Learn here, then graduate to the reef.

activities.name: Surfing (beginners & experts)
activities.description: Beach break for learners, reef points for chargers — surf schools line the bay.

activities.name: Stilt fishermen (Ahangama)
activities.description: See the iconic stilt fishermen at nearby Ahangama — and try a pole yourself.

hotels.name: Weligama Bay Marriott Resort
hotels.blurb: Polished beachfront resort on the bay's curve.

destinations.name: Mirissa
destinations.description: The south coast's poster child — Coconut Tree Hill at sunset, blue whales offshore in season, and the Doctor's House when the sun goes down.

activities.name: Whale watching
activities.description: Blue whales, sperm whales and dolphins — November to April.

activities.name: Coconut Tree Hill
activities.description: The island's most photographed viewpoint — go for sunset.

activities.name: Snorkelling
activities.description: Turtles and reef fish in the bay's clear water.

activities.name: Parrot Rock
activities.description: A tiny island viewpoint at the harbour end of the beach.

activities.name: Club night (Doctor's House)
activities.description: The famous Saturday party in a Bawa-era villa.

hotels.name: Mandara Resort Mirissa
hotels.blurb: Stylish beachfront resort with a popular beach club.

destinations.name: Galle
destinations.description: A 400-year-old Dutch fort filled with cafes, galleries and lighthouse views — the island's most romantic town. Stay inside the ramparts, dine on the walls at sunset.

activities.name: Galle Dutch Fort walk
activities.description: Ramparts, lighthouse, museums and Dutch-era streets — best at golden hour.

activities.name: Stilt fishermen's area
activities.description: The iconic fishermen of Ahangama and Koggala — photos and pole-trying.

activities.name: Seafood lunch
activities.description: Choose from the fort's best seafood restaurants — we book your table.

activities.name: Surfing (beginners)
activities.description: Gentle breaks at nearby Dewata and Unawatuna.

activities.name: Unawatuna & Thalpe beaches
activities.description: Swim, sunbathe and beach-hop the coast's prettiest bays.

activities.name: Lunuganga — Geoffrey Bawa's estate
activities.description: The legendary architect's garden estate between Galle and Bentota.

activities.name: Evening high tea
activities.description: High tea inside the fort with rampart views.

hotels.name: Jetwing Lighthouse
hotels.blurb: Bawa-designed icon on the rocks north of the fort.

hotels.name: Fort Bazaar
hotels.blurb: Chic 17th-century merchant house turned boutique hotel.

destinations.name: Bentota & Beruwala
destinations.description: The classic beach-resort coast — wide golden beaches, the winding Madu river and turtle hatcheries. The island's easiest beach escape from Colombo.

activities.name: Madu river safari
activities.description: Boat through mangrove tunnels to cinnamon island and temple island.

activities.name: Sea turtle hatchery
activities.description: See rescued turtles and release babies into the surf.

activities.name: Water sports
activities.description: Jet-ski, banana boat and windsurf on the Bentota river.

hotels.name: Cinnamon Bey Beruwala
hotels.blurb: Bawa-inspired beachfront resort with a huge pool.

hotels.name: Taj Bentota Resort & Spa
hotels.blurb: Palatial beach resort between river and sea.

destinations.name: Colombo
destinations.description: End where the island buzzes loudest — Galle Face sunsets, Pettah's chaos, world-class dining and rooftop bars. One night here ties the whole journey together.

activities.name: Galle Face Green & old fort
activities.description: Sunset street food on the ocean promenade, colonial streets behind.

activities.name: Pettah market
activities.description: The city's chaotic bazaar — everything from spices to electronics.

activities.name: Dining & nightlife
activities.description: The island's best restaurants and rooftop bars.

hotels.name: Cinnamon Grand Colombo
hotels.blurb: The city's grand dame with 10 restaurants.

hotels.name: Galle Face Hotel
hotels.blurb: Historic 1864 hotel facing the ocean promenade.

destinations.name: Ratnapura
destinations.description: Where the island's famous sapphires come from — descend into a working gem mine, wash for stones in the river and learn why 'Ratnapura' means city of gems.

activities.name: Gem mine visit
activities.description: Go underground in a traditional pit mine and try gem washing.

activities.name: Gem museum
activities.description: See record-breaking sapphires and learn to spot fakes.

businesses.name: Ratnapura gem traders
businesses.blurb: Licensed gem merchants — every purchase certified. Arrange viewings through Ariva.

destinations.name: Sinharaja
destinations.description: Sri Lanka's last virgin rainforest — a UNESCO wilderness of endemic birds, purple-faced monkeys and trees that have stood for centuries. Walk it with a naturalist guide.

activities.name: Rainforest guided walk
activities.description: Half or full day with a naturalist — endemic birds, lizards and giant trees.

activities.name: Birdwatching

faqs.q: How does the price work when I customise?
faqs.a: You only ever see one total price, shown in your own currency. Add or remove destinations and activities and the total recalculates instantly — individual activity prices are never displayed.

faqs.q: Can I choose my own guide?
faqs.a: Yes. Every Ariva guide has a public profile with real guest reviews. Pick your favourite when you book, and we'll confirm availability.

faqs.q: How do hotel choices work per tier?
faqs.a: Silver travellers choose from 4+ handpicked hotels per destination, Gold from 5 proposed 5-star hotels, and Platinum from 10+ luxury properties. Every hotel links to its own website so you can browse before you decide.
Our site is in English, and we'll suggest your language based on your country — you choose whether to switch. Our guides speak English plus German, French, Chinese, Russian and more on request.
Build your journey in the trip customiser, then send it to us. We call you back to fine-tune every detail before anything is confirmed — no payment is taken online.
